mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that prompt equity investors to anticipate lower corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return pattern fails when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline simultaneously in more than 50% of cases without negative 60d returns, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a decline in the core inflation rate signals that the Federal Reserve may delay rate hikes, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances during high inflation, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.025.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units, it indicates a weakening housing market that typically precedes a decline in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 45% of instances when HOUST < 900.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic contraction that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return pattern fails when both PAYEMS and INDPRO decline simultaneously in more than 50% of cases without negative 60d returns, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below $400 billion (in millions of dollars) signals an impending slowdown in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS < 400000.0 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% for two consecutive months signals persistent labor market weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 42% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5% for 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
